title: 11 Best Schnitzel in Vienna
description: The best Wiener Schnitzel in Vienna — curated from hundreds of Reddit reviews. From legendary Figlmüller to hidden local Gasthäuser. Interactive map included.

places.name: Figlmüller

redditQuotes.text: Although it's a tourist trap, I do like Figlmüller. But it is a bit like pizza in Naples, you will get good Schnitzel at every semi-decent place in Vienna.
redditQuotes.source: — r/wien · Tourist questions — schnitzels and beer

redditQuotes.text: What started as a Heurigen has become one of the most famous restaurants in the city. The Figlmüller house speciality Schnitzel is special because it is super thin and light.
redditQuotes.source: — Vienna Würstelstand · 8 Best Schnitzel in Vienna

places.verdict: Love it or call it a tourist trap — Figlmüller delivers.

comparison.best for: Iconic Since 1905 in Wollzeile, Innere Stadt with a €18–€25/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 6,893 Google reviews · Iconic Since 1905 · Wollzeile, Innere Stadt
comparison.limitations: the recipe hasn't changed since 1905 and the quality is consistent
comparison.why it made the list: Love it or call it a tourist trap — Figlmüller delivers. The schnitzel is genuinely excellent: paper-thin, shatteringly crispy, and bigger than your head. Yes, there's a queue. Yes, many tourists. But the recipe hasn't changed since 1905 and the quality is consistent. Locals are split, but even the skeptics admit the schnitzel itself is good. Reserve online, go to the original Wollzeile address, and don't overthink it.
comparison.what to order: Figlmüller, an iconic schnitzel institution since 1905 located on Wollzeile in Innere Stadt, offers its house specialty for €18–€25 per person. The pork schnitzel is famed for hanging over the plate's edge due to its thinness; pair it with their Erdäpfelsalat (Viennese potato salad). While a veal version exists, the pork is what truly made them famous. Secure a reservation at the original Wollzeile location, as the Bäckerstraße branch, while good, lacks the same atmosphere.

places.name: Meissl & Schadn

redditQuotes.text: If you'd like a posh place probably Meissl and Schadn is the best address.
redditQuotes.source: — r/wien · Tourist questions — schnitzels and beer

places.verdict: This is where you go when you want the schnitzel elevated to fine dining.

comparison.best for: Upscale Schnitzel in Schubertring, Innere Stadt with a €22–€35/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 6,327 Google reviews · Upscale Schnitzel · Schubertring, Innere Stadt
comparison.why it made the list: This is where you go when you want the schnitzel elevated to fine dining. Named after a legendary 19th-century Viennese hotel restaurant, Meissl & Schadn (opened 2019) takes the dish seriously — real veal, precise technique, elegant presentation. It's the most expensive schnitzel on this list, but the quality is undeniable. Perfect for a special occasion or anniversary dinner. The location on the Ringstraße opposite Stadtpark is gorgeous.
comparison.what to order: Meissl & Schadn, located on Schubertring in Innere Stadt, offers an upscale schnitzel experience for €22–€35 per person. The veal Wiener Schnitzel is the highlight, boasting a perfectly souffléd and billowing golden coating; they offer multiple cuts and sizes. Consider trying the Tafelspitz, a dish that revives the name of a legendary 19th-century Viennese restaurant. Complement your meal with a glass of Austrian Grüner Veltliner.

places.verdict: If you want the definitive veal schnitzel experience without the fine-dining price tag of Meissl & Schadn, Skopik & Lohn is your spot.

places.name: Schnitzelwirt

redditQuotes.text: The food takes little time to be served, and before you know it you are facing two sizzling, giant, golden pieces of coated pork waiting to be devoured. They make a very decent Schnitzel — their glowing reviews have more to do with the mammoth size, rather than quality alone.
redditQuotes.source: — Vienna Würstelstand · 8 Best Schnitzel in Vienna

redditQuotes.text: Both Figlmüller and Schnitzel Wirt get locals and tourists, quite reasonable in price. Great atmosphere and staff in Schnitzel Wirt. This is also cash only.
redditQuotes.source: — Rick Steves Forum · Wiener schnitzel in Vienna

places.verdict: Schnitzelwirt does exactly one thing and does it well: enormous, crispy, affordable schnitzels in a no-frills setting.

comparison.best for: Best Budget Schnitzel in Neubaugasse, Neubau with a €10–€16/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 11,844 Google reviews · Best Budget Schnitzel · Neubaugasse, Neubau
comparison.limitations: at this price-to-size ratio, it's unbeatable
comparison.why it made the list: Schnitzelwirt does exactly one thing and does it well: enormous, crispy, affordable schnitzels in a no-frills setting. The name literally means "Schnitzel Inn" — there's no pretension here. Cash only, served fast, eaten faster. It's not the most refined schnitzel in Vienna, but at this price-to-size ratio, it's unbeatable. Perfect for budget travelers, big appetites, or anyone who believes bigger is better. Students, backpackers, and honest-to-god locals pack this place nightly.
comparison.what to order: Schnitzelwirt, found on Neubaugasse in Neubau, is the best spot for budget schnitzel, serving giant portions for €10–€16 per person. Opt for the giant pork schnitzel, known for its comical size and remarkably cheap price; remember to bring cash as they don't accept cards. The food arrives quickly, so pair it with a simple green salad to balance the richness. Don't expect gourmet, but a very tasty and large schnitzel at a very fair price.

places.name: Gasthaus Pöschl

redditQuotes.text: It's a challenge to find true-to-Vienna traditional restaurants in the tourist-saturated city center, which makes the existence of Gasthaus Pöschl all the more precious. The inside is small, cozy, and cramped, the food more elevated than the informal decor would indicate.
redditQuotes.source: — Offbeat Budapest · Best Schnitzel Restaurants in Vienna

places.verdict: Gasthaus Pöschl is that rare thing: an excellent restaurant in the 1st district that's actually frequented by locals.

comparison.best for: Hidden Gem in Weihburggasse, Innere Stadt with a €15–€25/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 3,096 Google reviews · Hidden Gem · Weihburggasse, Innere Stadt
comparison.why it made the list: Gasthaus Pöschl is that rare thing: an excellent restaurant in the 1st district that's actually frequented by locals. The small, cozy interior and phone-only reservations keep the tourist hordes at bay. The schnitzel is quietly outstanding — crispy exterior, juicy meat, proper technique. What elevates Pöschl is the whole experience: start with their legendary beef broth, move to the schnitzel, finish with Kaiserschmarrn. This is how Viennese people actually dine.
comparison.what to order: Gasthaus Pöschl, a hidden gem on Weihburggasse in Innere Stadt, offers a delightful schnitzel experience for €15–€25 per person. Start with the Rindsuppe (beef broth), which is exceptional, followed by their crispy and juicy schnitzel of elevated quality. The Kaiserschmarrn for dessert is also highly recommended. Book ahead by phone, as the place is small and popular with regulars.

places.name: Café Rüdigerhof

redditQuotes.text: A 1903 art nouveau jewel that's long been a beloved bohemian haunt, the Rüdigerhof serves a deliciously golden brown Wiener Schnitzel, along with a menu of Viennese classics. The pork schnitzel is fluffy and light, which may be a result of it being fried in lard, rather than oil.
redditQuotes.source: — Vienna Würstelstand / Accor Limitless · 8 Best Schnitzel in Vienna

places.verdict: Rüdigerhof is the schnitzel spot for people who appreciate beautiful spaces.

comparison.best for: Art Nouveau Gem in Hamburgerstraße, Margareten with a €14–€22/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 2,054 Google reviews · Art Nouveau Gem · Hamburgerstraße, Margareten
comparison.why it made the list: Rüdigerhof is the schnitzel spot for people who appreciate beautiful spaces. This 1903 art nouveau café-restaurant in the 5th district is the kind of place your grandparents would have loved — and that's a compliment. The lard-fried schnitzel is genuinely different from the norm: lighter, fluffier, with a richer flavor. The location is well outside the tourist circuit (near the Naschmarkt area), so you'll mostly be surrounded by locals. The garden courtyard in summer is magical.
comparison.what to order: Café Rüdigerhof, an Art Nouveau gem located on Hamburgerstraße in Margareten, serves schnitzel for €14–€22 per person. Try the pork schnitzel fried in lard, which creates a different, fluffier texture than the standard oil-fried version. The whole menu features solid Viennese classics. In summer, grab a table in the garden courtyard and pair your meal with a local beer.

places.verdict: Pfarrwirt is the destination schnitzel — worth the trip out to Heiligenstadt in the 19th district.

places.name: Reinthaler

redditQuotes.text: When it comes to enjoying your classic schnitzel in a small and cozy space, you will not find a better place than Reinthaler. The place is usually packed with locals and offers a great price point — one of the best schnitzels in Vienna on a low budget.
redditQuotes.source: — The Vienna Blog · Best Wiener Schnitzel in Vienna

comparison.best for: Old-School Local in Gluckgasse, Innere Stadt with a €12–€18/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 3,598 Google reviews · Old-School Local · Gluckgasse, Innere Stadt
comparison.why it made the list: Reinthaler is time travel. This tiny Beisl in the 1st district hasn't changed in decades — and that's the point. No Instagram aesthetics, no tourist menu, no English spoken (well, maybe a little). Just a packed room of regulars eating large, crispy schnitzels at prices that feel almost apologetic for central Vienna. If you want to understand what "everyday Viennese dining" actually looks like, Reinthaler is the purest expression of it. Come hungry, bring cash, be patient.
comparison.what to order: Reinthaler, an old-school local spot on Gluckgasse in Innere Stadt, serves Wiener Schnitzel for €12–€18 per person. Order the Wiener Schnitzel with potato salad for a simple, classic, and well-executed meal. The place is small and packed with regulars, so visit during off-peak hours. Expect no reservations, no frills, just queue and eat in an authentically old Vienna Beisl (tavern) atmosphere.

places.name: Salzamt

redditQuotes.text: Tucked away in the middle of the infamous Bermuda Triangle party area, Salzamt seems as though time has stood still since it opened in 1983. The Schnitzel really shines in its seasoning.
redditQuotes.source: — Vienna Würstelstand · 8 Best Schnitzel in Vienna

places.verdict: Salzamt proves that schnitzel doesn't need to be plate-sized to be great.

comparison.best for: Bermuda Triangle Classic in Ruprechtsplatz, Innere Stadt with a €16–€24/person spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 968 Google reviews · Bermuda Triangle Classic · Ruprechtsplatz, Innere Stadt
comparison.limitations: possibly the most flavorful schnitzel on this list
comparison.why it made the list: Salzamt proves that schnitzel doesn't need to be plate-sized to be great. While other places compete on size, Salzamt competes on flavor — the seasoning is what sets their schnitzel apart. The Bermuda Triangle location means you can have an excellent dinner and walk straight into Vienna's nightlife. The restaurant has barely changed since 1983, giving it a genuine time-capsule quality. Not the cheapest, not the biggest, but possibly the most flavorful schnitzel on this list.
comparison.what to order: Salzamt, a Bermuda Triangle classic located on Ruprechtsplatz in Innere Stadt, offers schnitzel for €16–€24 per person. The schnitzel here shines through its seasoning – perfectly balanced, not oversized, just right. Its location in the Bermuda Triangle (Vienna's bar/nightlife district near Schwedenplatz) makes it a perfect dinner-before-going-out spot, complemented by a solid wine list.
